messages:
Alex W: Heads-up — we need to lock the per-route quota + billing-field contract for the next release. Key asks: per-route hard caps, token accounting rules (especially around function/tool calls), and mapping to pricing fields. Can we decide scope today?

Rachel P: +1. FinRegCo and a couple of other enterprises want: per-route hard cap, burst tokens per hour, and the ability to exempt internal/admin routes from quotas. They also asked that billing can optionally exclude tool-call arguments (they only want model tokens charged).

Samir K: FYI runtime note: we currently bill tokens from the model side which includes function-call payloads, tool args, and streaming chunks. Excluding tool args requires plumbing token attribution from the tool-caller back into billing before final accounting — non-trivial with streaming + KV cache.

Kevin T: From pricing/billing side I propose two surface fields to start with: `billing_unit` (tokens | requests | embeddings) and `include_function_tokens` (true | false). For quotas add `route_quota` with `{period, limit, burst}`. Also suggest we expose simple quota headers: `X-Quota-Remaining` and `X-Quota-Reset`.

Alex W: Example route manifest (proposal):

```json
{
  "route_id": "chat-conversation",
  "billing_unit": "tokens",
  "include_function_tokens": false,
  "quota": { "period": "hour", "limit": 1000000, "burst": 200000 }
}
```

Rachel P: Launch criteria from GTM/customer-success: docs + migration guide, SDK updates to expose headers & errors, billing pipeline tests, and an opt-in path for current customers. Must-have for launch: clear contract for what tokens count.

Samir K: Implementation risk/rollout suggestion: default behavior = include_function_tokens: true (no change), and enable `include_function_tokens=false` gradually for Dedicated/Private customers first. That reduces complexity while we add attribution hooks.

Kevin T: Agreed. Also need a mapping from `billing_unit` -> pricing_column in our billing DB. I'll own that mapping + tests. Canary plan: enable on a few accounts, monitor delta in monthly spend & token counts.

QuotaBot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/quotas-1900 — please comment.

Alex W: Decisions summary: 1) API will support `billing_unit` + `include_function_tokens` + `quota` fields. 2) Default: include_function_tokens=true. 3) Exclude option will be gated to Dedicated/Private for initial rollout. 4) Expose standard quota headers and error codes (429 + body with remaining/reset).

Rachel P: Action items: I'll draft the customer comms + migration guide.

Samir K: I'll scope runtime work and post a PR for token attribution changes.

Kevin T: I'll update billing mapping + create canary test plan.

Alex W: Great — let's reconvene Thursday after Samir's PR and Kevin's canary plan. :thumbsup:
